articles.title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military
articles.highlight: 赫格塞思称，美军抓获马杜罗是“拉丁美洲历史上最精密的一次军事行动”。
articles.summary: 美国国防部长赫格塞思首次访问委内瑞拉，并在行程中高调宣扬美军于1月3日凌晨由“三角洲”部队抓走前总统马杜罗的行动。报道指出，这一争议性的越境抓捕意外促成了华盛顿与执政自1999年的“查韦斯派”政权之间的缓和。这条新闻值得一读，因为它展示了武力行动与后续政治结果之间出人意料的落差。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点在于：一次单方面的军事抓捕并未导向预期的对抗升级，反而撬动了美委关系的意外缓和；因此判断此类行动时，不能只看战术层面的成功，还要看它在政治上会引发哪些连锁反应。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Defense secretary asserts US dominance on trip that would have seemed ‘impossible, almost unbelievable’ a year ago Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”. Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.

en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that a unilateral military capture did not escalate confrontation but instead opened an unexpected opening with Caracas, so tactical success should not be mistaken for predictable political outcomes.

articles.highlight: 不在谈判桌旁，你或你的价值观就可能被列入菜单，面临被瓜分的风险。
articles.summary: 这篇《卫报》直播报道聚焦深圳APEC峰会期间习近平欢迎特朗普访华、普京称欧洲陷入“屈辱性衰退”，并引述分析担忧特朗普、习近平与普京的会晤可能像雅尔塔一样带来大国交易。文章值得读在于它把峰会外交姿态与乌克兰、东欧和波罗的海国家、台湾、伊朗等被排除者的风险联系起来，提醒读者关注谁在桌旁、谁可能被“菜单化”。

en.highlight: If you are not around the table, the risk is that you, or your values, are on the menu and about to be carved up.
en.summary: This Guardian live report covers the APEC summit in Shenzhen, where Xi welcomes Trump on a China visit and Putin claims Europe is in ‘humiliating decline.’ It highlights Patrick Wintour’s warning that a Trump-Xi-Putin meeting could produce a Yalta-style carve-up, leaving excluded parties such as Ukraine, eastern Europe and the Baltics, Taiwan and Iran exposed. articles.title: Make Learning Permanent
articles.highlight: 如果今天让你重考高中某门课的期末试卷，你还能及格吗？
articles.summary: 文章从高中期末考试的记忆切入，提到 Harry Bahrick 和 Lynda Hall 一项询问近两千人的著名研究。已知开头显示，多数人预期离开学校几年后知识会明显遗忘；文章由此讨论如何让学习更持久。它值得读，是因为它把“学过”与“长期记住”区分开来。

en.highlight: If I gave you one of your high-school final exams today, could you still pass it?
en.summary: The article opens with the memory of high-school final exams and cites a famous study by Harry Bahrick and Lynda Hall that asked nearly two thousand people this question. The known opening suggests most people expect substantial forgetting a few years after leaving school, and the article discusses how to make learning more permanent. articles.sourceExcerpt: EM-SDTrack: Efficient Multi-Scale Spike-driven Tracking for Event Cameras Yimeng Shan1,2, Haodi Wu1, Wei Zheng1, Xiaowei Ye3, Shuai Wang1,2, Yu Liang1,2, Wei Hua3, Chenxiao Dou3, Malu Zhang†1,2 1University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, China 2Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, China 3China Nanhu Academy of Electronics and Information Technology, China yimengshan2001@gmail.com Code:https://github.com/YmShan/EM-SDTrack Abstract Event-driven spiking neural networks (SNNs) match the sparse spatiotemporal output of event cameras, making spike-driven trackers highly attractive for neuromorphic edge deployment. However, events reveal a target only through their spatial distribution, whose extent varies more than tenfold within one sequence. Event tracking therefore demands multi-scale representation, which existing spike- driven trackers lack.

articles.summary: 该 GitHub 仓库是 ARTEX 的全球版，定位为大语言模型驱动的多智能体自主渗透测试框架，默认英文并支持韩文、中文、西班牙文和日文切换。它仅面向授权、防御与检测用途，上游为 Autumn-27/ARTEX，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。当前约 3963 星，适合用来观察 LLM 多智能体在安全测试中的工程化边界与合规风险。
articles.failureAnalysis: 自主渗透测试属于高风险双用途能力，若授权边界、审计日志和滥用防护不严，会带来法律与合规风险。多智能体自动规划可能产生误报、破坏性操作或难以复现的结果，真实客户环境验证成本高。LLM 调用成本和长任务可靠性也会限制规模化部署；3963 星只说明关注度，不等于商业需求或安全效果已被验证。

en.highlight: ARTEX Global is an LLM multi-agent autonomous penetration-testing framework, intended only for authorized defensive and detection use.
en.summary: This GitHub repository is the global edition of ARTEX, positioned as an LLM-driven multi-agent autonomous penetration-testing framework; it defaults to English and can switch among Korean, Chinese, Spanish, and Japanese. It is restricted to authorized, defensive, and detection use, with upstream Autumn-27/ARTEX under AGPL-3.0. Its roughly 3,963 stars make it worth reading as a signal of how LLM agents are being applied to security testing, but not as proof of validated security outcomes.
en.failureAnalysis: Autonomous penetration testing is a high-risk dual-use capability: weak authorization boundaries, audit logs, or abuse controls create legal and compliance exposure. Multi-agent planning can produce false positives, destructive actions, or hard-to-reproduce results, while real-environment validation and LLM inference costs limit scale; stars indicate attention, not commercial demand or proven security impact.
en.title: ARTEX Global: An LLM Multi-Agent Autonomous Penetration-Testing Framework
